# qrcodegen 1.8.0

This directory contains the pure Rust `qrcodegen` crate used by the ASL desktop
UI to produce QR module matrices. It is vendored so `asl-ui` can be built with
`--locked --offline` from a clean checkout.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator>
- Release: `qrcodegen` 1.8.0
- Crate archive checksum: `4339fc7a1021c9c1621d87f5e3505f2805c8c105420ba2f2a4df86814590c142`
- License: MIT (the copyright and permission notice is in `src/lib.rs`)
- Vendored: 2026-11-26

Only the crate manifest, source, and upstream readme are retained. The
normalized `Cargo.toml` was copied from crates.io; `Cargo.toml.orig` records the
upstream manifest.
